What you earn

You earn a share of the profit on every house you sell, and the share grows once you are established. How much profit a house makes depends on the model, and on the materials and options the customer picks, so the figures below are estimated ranges rather than fixed amounts.

Your first five sales€3,500 to €7,500A 50% share of the profit on each house, with the lower end on our simplest builds and the upper end on our best.
Every sale after that€4,500 to €10,000Your share rises to 67% and stays there for every sale after the fifth.
When you are paidWithin 10 daysCounted from the day the customer pays their invoice, not from some quarterly cycle.
What it costs you€150 a monthThe hub subscription, and nothing else. A single sale covers at least two years of it.

A branded copy of our website under your own domain is available if you want one, at €100 to set up and €150 a month.

What you are selling

Our own models run from compact mobile tiny houses you can pull behind a car to modular full-size family homes. Over 250 delivered across Europe since 2017, and every review on Trustpilot is five stars.

The risk stays with us

The parts that keep most people out of this business are the parts you never carry.

  • No stock to buy and no house to finance
  • No display unit requiredAlmost all of our customers buy without ever visiting one. Every house has a 3D walkthrough on our website, so a customer can look around one without standing in it.
  • No production, transport or installation risk
  • No warranty liabilityWe carry the guarantee and the cost of putting anything right. You stay your customer’s point of contact, we do the work behind you.
  • No product development and no pricing to guessModels, specifications and prices come ready from our retailer hub, and your own automated quote calculator is live from day one.
  • No marketing material to producePhotography, catalogues and blog posts come with the partnership, and a branded copy of our website under your own domain is available from the start, so you can be marketing in your first week instead of spending months building a library.

What it takes

Finding the customers

  • Roughly 10 to 15 hours a weekEnough to work a market properly, without replacing what you already do.
  • We do not hand you leadsYour own market and your own marketing are the job. That is exactly why the margin share is so generous.
  • You already know how to reach buyersYou already advertise, run social channels and turn up at local events and home shows.

Looking after them

  • An answer within 24 hoursThese are people spending serious money, and silence loses them.
  • Somebody covers when you are awayHolidays should not stop a customer getting a reply, so you need a backup person who can pick up leads and viewings while you are out.
  • Comfortable meeting customers either waySome want to sit down with you, most are happy on a call. Since no showroom is required, the conversation runs by phone, WhatsApp or live video as often as it does in person.

Seeing it through

  • Permits and zoning, explained calmlyA nervous first-time buyer needs someone who knows the local rules.
  • The practical side, coordinatedMost of our houses need very little site preparation. The larger ones can, and customers often arrange that themselves, but being the person who coordinates the crane, the foundation and the utilities on the day is worth a lot to them. Your own subcontractors are fine, and we tell you what the house needs.
  • It does not end at deliveryYour customer keeps coming to you afterwards, and you keep the relationship. The warranty work happens behind you.

A pace that is realistic

The first six months are a trial for both of us, with no obligation on either side to carry on. If it works, we move to a long-term agreement.

First six months2 housesOne a quarter, during the trial.
First full year6 housesOne every two months.
Second year10 housesOnce you know the product, roughly one a month.

Six houses in a first year works out somewhere between €22,000 and €47,000, depending which models you sell.

Is this you?

This works well if

  • You already meet people who have land and are looking for a house to put on it
  • A sale at €50,000 or more is routine for you, not an event
  • You have your own way of reaching customers, whether that is a shop, a site, a network or a following
  • You want another product line rather than a whole new business

This does not work if

  • You are looking for passive income or a lead-forwarding scheme
  • You would have to build a customer pipeline from nothing
  • You are a one-person operation with nobody to cover you
  • You already sell a competing tiny house brand
  • You cannot reliably answer a customer within 24 hours

If the right-hand column describes you, do not write us off. Our referral programme pays 2% of the sale price for nothing more than an introduction, with none of the commitments that come with a retailership. It costs you nothing to try, and if it turns out to work for you, becoming a full retailer is open to you later.

Contact us if that sounds like you and you would like to know more.
